LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFFS GEORGE MCKRAY, ANTHONY LAMPERTI AND ELIZABETH LAMPERTI'S NOTICE OF MOTION AND MOTION TO SET ASIDE AND VACATE JUDGMENT AND ENTER ANOTHER AND DIFFERENT JUDGMENT IS DENIED, PLAINTIFFS BRIEF VIOLATES CRC 3.1113(D) WITHOUT COMPLYING WITH 3.1113(E). THE COURT EXERCISES ITS DISCRETION UNDER CRC 3.1113(G) AND 3.1300 TO DISREGARD THE FILING WHICH LEAVES THE MOTION UNSUPPORTED FOR THE PURPOSES OF 3.1113(A). EVEN IF THE COURT CONSIDERED THE FILING HOWEVER, THE MOTION WOULD BE DENIED ON THE MERITS BECAUSE AMONG OTHER REASONS, IT SEEKS RELIEF THIS COURT CANNOT ACCORD. PLAINTIFF REQUEST TO EXCLUDE THE PARTY ON THE PAYMENT OF THE FEES IS DENIED. PREVAILING PARTY TO SUBMIT A FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER, CAROL A. KAREN, CSR # 8189
